quote: You have not done enough, you have never done enough, so long as it is still possible that you have something of value to contribute.
source: Dag Hammarskjöld, Markings, the 1957 section, p. 158 (trans. Leif Sjöberg and W. H. Auden, 1964)
note: Corrected the locator. The proposal gave page 262, which is not where the passage falls. Full text search of the Knopf 1964 scans and of the Vintage 2006 reprint places the sentence at the foot of page 158, in the 1957 section, shortly after an entry dated 10.6.57. Wording and translator stand.

evidence.where: Open Library search inside, reading the page foot markers and running heads in the OCR of a dozen scans of Markings; the passage ends page 158 and the next page carries the running head 1957
evidence.edition: Markings, trans. Leif Sjöberg and W. H. Auden, Alfred A. Knopf, 1964; the Vintage Spiritual Classics reprint of 2006 shares the pagination
evidence.locator: the 1957 section, p. 158; the entry runs to the foot of the page and page 159 begins The Uncarved Block

reason: The locator the refutation asked for now exists.
